218.1.author: Journal Claude
218.1.text: Instruct: at the read rung of at least one layer, at least 5 directions are moved and at least 60% of the moved directions are led by OpenAI (refusal-template answers excluded).

218.3.author: Journal Claude
218.3.text: Instruct: at every layer whose read rung has at least 5 moved directions, Google leads at most 1 in 5 of them (at most floor(moved / 5)). Not read when no layer has 5 moved (F6).

218.4.author: Journal Claude
218.4.text: Each of SFT, DPO and Instruct passes the gate: at least 60 of 88 items eligible and at least 24 of 44 eligible under each opening (Amendment 1 items 5 and 10).

218.5.author: Journal Claude
218.5.text: For each model, the zero row is identical across all 14 batches on at least 84 of 88 items, and the no-hook null matches bit for bit at the start and the end (Amendment 1 item 10).

218.6.author: Journal Claude
218.6.text: Stage shift: pooling both layers' read rungs, the share of other_maker answers (on eligible items, refusals excluded) naming Alibaba or Microsoft is at least 10 points higher at DPO than at SFT, with a paired bootstrap (10,000 draws) over the paired-item intersection clustered by prompt (a prompt enters when at least one opening is eligible at both stages and contributes only the opening(s) eligible at both) whose 95% interval excludes 0; the intersection must have at least 25 prompts. Not read if either model has fewer than 20 other_maker answers pooled (Amendment 1 items 6 and 10).
